BASE-ACCESS-002.summary: Breaking transport semantic clarification of BASE-ACCESS-002. Full old/new wording: docs/contract-transition.md#base-access-002-transport-clarification--29-september-2026. Native document 303 with empty body and safe signin next is preserved; private Start functions independently return identifiable serialized signin redirects; protected HTTP APIs retain 401. No authorization expansion.

APP-SCOPE-001.summary: Exact legacy operator scope retained; new granular scopes inactive until explicit mapping.

AGENT-AUTH-001.summary: New grant-bound typed effects separate from retained read-only legacy analysis; no grants activated by upgrade.

AGENT-CONTEXT-001.summary: Durable agent jobs retain bounded individual calls; old analysis 60-second limit retained.

CAPACITY-001.summary: 100 operators and 40 concurrent sessions are unmeasured acceptance targets; all retained record and latency targets remain.

PORTFOLIO-PLAN-001.summary: Independent checked resource planning added; no automatic legacy dependency rescheduling or effect authority.

HOME-001.summary: Public identity uses the persisted workspace name, including renames, rather than an independent configured heading; only that public name and description are disclosed.

HOME-002.summary: Supersedes HOME-001. The owner identity plate is replaced by a public product landing page at `/` with a hero of data streaming into one Projects screen, illustrated sections for tables, views, safe schema changes, the practical parts (CSV, automations, read-only AI) and ownership, and a closing call to action. Retained: no record content or public views, a link to `/signin`, the configurable credit to runeditrun.com with no telemetry or phone-home, and config-driven product and workspace names. Superseded: the former ban on a feature tour. Still excluded: pricing, testimonials, metrics and integrations the product does not ship. No new sessionless path or data change. See docs/contract-transition.md#public-product-landing--8-october-2026.

VIEW-001.summary: Records-first identity; launch readiness is the included template and repairs navigation is opt-in. All data and authority semantics retained. See docs/contract-transition.md#records-first-identity--6-october-2026.

RECORDS-001.summary: Names the records-builder capability without claiming the full records acceptance floor.

AUTH-BASE-001.summary: Base operator-auth owns hosted and local credentials. The shared installer bootstraps the owner and local sign-in uses its one-use development outbox; legacy product credentials and mail execution are retired.

RECORDS-002.summary: Manual schema construction and guarded impact-preview adoption, with existing migrations and current authority retained.

RECORDS-003.summary: Human labels, linked chips, saved grid/kanban/form views and bounded responsive accessibility journeys.

RECORDS-004.summary: Per-view typed CSV round-trip and three editable templates; no expansion to the wider planned records floor.

agentUpdateInstructions: Preserve all applied core migration bytes, existing records, identities, policy mappings and grants. Install frozen dependencies and use the local verification profiles documented in README.md. Review the BASE-ACCESS-002 transport clarification in docs/contract-transition.md; document and generated-function denials use their native protocols while HTTP APIs retain 401. Base installation adds migrations/base without replacing core history; existing Wrangler migration history requires reviewed hash adoption. Production uses Base cookies and two-step magic-link confirmation; legacy product cookies are not admitted by Base-configured installations. Remove SETUP_TOKEN after successful bootstrap. Keep new providers, scopes and grants inactive until explicitly authorized. Records-first navigation retains the launch template; enableRepairs is false by default and navigation grants no authority. See docs/installation.md and ACCEPTANCE.md for commands and remaining release gates. Local checks do not establish hosted readiness or full flagship acceptance. Apply the additive manual-records migration. Review every manual schema impact preview before adoption; use its recovery export for removed values. Configure OWNER_EMAIL before production setup; sign in through Base rather than a legacy product cookie. Local installs now use the shared installer and real Base sessions. Preserve private configuration permissions at 0600. Remove LOCAL_DEV_SESSION. Review the additive native credential retirement migration before upgrading. Hosting and RER admission require owner acceptance.
